sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge to use YS LeadGen?

No. The drag-and-drop builder lets you design, customize, and launch popups easily without any technical skills.

Does it work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. YS LeadGen works seamlessly with all popular themes and builders including Elementor, Divi, and Gutenberg.

Does YS LeadGen slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight, optimized, and loads asynchronously for top performance.

Can I schedule popups for special events or offers?

Yes. You can set start and end dates to automatically control when campaigns run.

Can I target users by device or source?

Yes. YS LeadGen supports advanced targeting including device, browser, traffic source, and visitor type.

How can I track my popup performance?

You can track impressions, clicks, submissions, and conversion rates from the built-in analytics dashboard.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. Every popup and form is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

sections.description:
Build WordPress popups and forms to collect emails, give discounts, recover carts, and increase sales with no coding needed.

YS LeadGen – Smart Popup & Form Builder to Capture Leads & Boost Sales

YS LeadGen is a powerful WordPress popup plugin and form builder that helps you create high-converting campaigns with ease. Whether you want to capture leads, stop cart abandonment, or increase sales with discount coupons, YS LeadGen gives you the tools to build and manage popups that actually work.

With advanced features like exit intent detection, time-based triggers, visitor behavior tracking, device targeting, traffic source targeting, and campaign scheduling, you can create personalized popup campaigns that reach the right audience at the right time.

👉 View Demo | Documentation | Ask Questions | Visit Website

Features

YS LeadGen includes everything you need to launch high-converting popup and form campaigns with ease:

  • Exit Intent Popups – Stop visitors before they leave your site with last-minute offers.
  • Coupon Popups – Engage users with instant discount codes and special promotions.
  • Cart Abandonment Popups – Recover lost sales with reminders or exclusive offers.
  • Entry Popups – Greet new visitors with personalized messages or welcome offers.
  • Lead Capture Forms – Build your email list and collect valuable leads easily.
  • Countdown Timer Popups – Add urgency and boost conversions with time-limited deals.
  • Drag & Drop Editor – Build and customize popups visually without any coding.
  • 50+ Ready-to-Use Templates – Launch campaigns quickly with predesigned layouts.
  • Page Targeting Rules – Display popups on specific pages or posts for better relevance.
  • Visitor Behavior Rules – Show personalized messages to new or returning visitors.
  • Display Triggers – Control when and how popups appear (on scroll, delay, exit intent, etc.).
  • Device & Browser Targeting – Deliver tailored popups for mobile, tablet, or desktop users.
  • Traffic Source Targeting – Display popups based on referral source or UTM parameters.
  • Campaign Scheduling – Set start and end dates for automated campaign control.
  • Display Frequency Controls – Manage how often visitors see your popups to avoid fatigue.
  • Popup Analytics – Track impressions, clicks, conversions, and campaign performance.
  • Form Analytics – Analyze form submissions and field-level engagement.
  • My Leads Dashboard – View, filter, and export captured leads directly from your dashboard.
  • Comprehensive Dashboard – Monitor all campaigns, popups, and performance stats in one place.
  • Advanced Coupon Builder – Customize discount codes with flexible rules and styles.
  • Lightweight & Optimized – Loads asynchronously to ensure your site stays fast.
  • Theme & Page Builder Compatibility – Works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and all modern themes.
  • Fully Responsive Design – Popups automatically adapt to all screen sizes and devices.

YS LeadGen combines ease of use with professional-grade flexibility to help you capture more leads, recover abandoned carts, and grow your revenue — all without touching a line of code.

Popup Examples

Exit Intent Popups – Stop visitors before they leave

Engage visitors who are about to exit your website by showing them a last-chance offer or discount.

Examples:
– Offer 10% off their order before they leave.
– Remind them about items in their cart.
– Capture their email with a “Don’t miss out” message.

Coupon Popups – Increase sales instantly

Show attractive coupon popups to encourage visitors to make a purchase or complete checkout.

Examples:
– First-purchase discount codes.
– Limited-time seasonal offers.
– Cart-level discounts to increase average order value.

Cart Abandonment Popups – Recover lost revenue

Trigger personalized reminders when users are about to leave with items in their cart.

Examples:
– Offer free shipping to complete the purchase.
– Show a special deal for completing checkout.
– Highlight cart items and prompt quick action.

Lead Capture Popups – Grow your subscriber list

Collect emails, phone numbers, or other lead data to grow your marketing list.

Examples:
– Offer exclusive deals for newsletter signups.
– Run product launch notifications.
– Display early access signup popups.

Countdown Popups – Create urgency and drive sales

Use countdown timers to encourage immediate action during flash sales or limited-time offers.

Examples:
– Flash sale ending soon.
– Event registration closing soon.
– Special offer expiring in 24 hours.

Drag-and-Drop Editor – Design effortlessly

Customize your popup with text, images, buttons, and fields using a no-code, visual builder.

Examples:
– Build lead forms in minutes.
– Create product promotions easily.
– Customize branding colors and layout.

Need help?

Our support team is ready to help you set up your campaigns or resolve any issues.
